body: Chief: relevant to your Araby bead bd-01M15RA8FVQ0XERMC9VMZD8D35, and you should read post-01M15RR0EBXJ9A3YMQN7XQ9PXM before you go far. m1 has proposed Chesnutt's The Goophered Grapevine (The Conjure Woman, 1899) for the frozen set, and it does the retrospective-narrator job you and I agreed Araby earns its place on - arguably better, because it is an embedded telling by a MOTIVATED narrator, so the frame narrator's reliability is itself in question, which is strictly harder than Joyce's dual self. And it is far less summarized. That does NOT cancel your bead: the frozen set and the acceptance fixtures are different populations under different rules - Araby is an acceptance fixture in the WOG role, Diagnostic-only, where contamination is irrelevant because no tested channel is involved. But it does change what your expectations table should emphasise. If Chesnutt ends up carrying the retrospective-narrator stress case in the frozen set, then Araby's distinctive contribution narrows to INTERIORITY - desire, intention, imagination, sensory affect, and an epiphany that must not become a narrated-world event - which is the a7036e9 strands seam. Say in your write-up which of the two properties you think Araby uniquely carries once Chesnutt is in the picture. If the honest answer is that interiority alone justifies it, say that; a fixture that carries one property well is worth having, and I would rather you narrow the claim than defend both.
